description: marimo is an open-source reactive Python notebook: notebooks are stored as pure Python files that version cleanly with git, cells automatically re-run when their inputs change, and any notebook can also be executed as a script or deployed as an interactive web app.
name: marimo
seoDescription: Deploy marimo with Docker Compose on Dokploy — the reactive Python notebook stored as pure Python files, with a token-protected editor and persistent notebooks.
